correctness.rationale: The exhaustive convolution derivation of the idempotent equations and the unique possible coefficient of (a-e)^2 reduces all fibers to an affine linear equation or to an exact r-variable bilinear dot-product count. The zero and nonzero right-hand-side counts and sharp maximization are reconstructed algebraically. Literal independent incidence multiplication passes 7,800 finite fibers over six cases, including GF(4).

value.rationale: A motivated restriction of a classical nil-clean invariant to square-zero remainders produces a family of genuine quadratic finite-field fibers and a non-power sharp index over unbounded diamond-width posets. The gap from the unrestricted q^(2r) index and the order-two/height-three boundary establish a nontrivial structural phenomenon; this is not a pure relabeling of a known idempotent total.
